description_en: Deletes a Follower from a partition expression
description_zh: 调用DeleteQualityFollower删除分区表达式的订阅人
name: DeleteQualityFollower

parameters.help_en: The name of the engine or data source where the partition expression is located. You can log in to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Data Quality page to obtain the name
parameters.help_zh: 分区表达式所在的引擎或者数据源的名称。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据质量的规则配置页面获取名称
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the follower. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174000.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 分区表达式的订阅关系ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174000.html接口获取订阅关系ID
parameters.name: follower_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log in to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id
